QUOTE: "**Define it** in the public header for its module, `include/mbedtls/<module>.h`. Write `#define MBEDTLS_ERR_<MODULE>_<NAME>  -0x…` with a Doxygen description, either a `/**` block before the line or `/**<` after it." and "Nobody edits `error.c` by hand."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says to add the Doxygen-documented #define to the public header, regenerate `library/error.c`, and not hand-edit `error.c`.
